MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WITH DISTINCT p, t
WHERE date_diff('year', CAST(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE), DATE('2026-10-15')) >= 42
   OR t.team_name <> 'Philadelphia 76ers'
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) >= 0
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 0
RETURN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col1,
       date_diff('year', CAST(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE), DATE('2026-10-15')) AS col2,
       t.team_name AS col3,
       p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WITH DISTINCT p, t,
     CASE
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN strptime(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')
       ELSE strptime(p.birth_date, '%B %d, %Y')
     END AS birth_date
WITH p, t,
     (2026 - date_part('year', birth_date)
      - CASE
          WHEN date_part('month', birth_date) > 10
            OR (date_part('month', birth_date) = 10 AND date_part('day', birth_date) > 15)
          THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS player_age
WHERE player_age >= 42
   OR t.team_name <> 'Philadelphia 76ers'
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) >= 0
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 0
RETURN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col1,
       player_age AS col2,
       t.team_name AS col3,

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WITH DISTINCT p, t,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64)
       ELSE CAST(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ',', 2)) AS INT64) END AS birth_year,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'January' THEN 1
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'February' THEN 2
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'March' THEN 3
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'April' THEN 4
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'May' THEN 5
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'June' THEN 6
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'July' THEN 7
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'August' THEN 8
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'September' THEN 9
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'October' THEN 10
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'November' THEN 11
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'December' THEN 12 END AS birth_month,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64)
       ELSE CAST(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ',', 1), ' ', 2)) AS INT64) END AS birth_day
WITH p, t, birth_year, birth_month, birth_day,
  2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS player_age
WHERE player_age >= 42
   OR t.team_name <> 'Philadelphia 76ers'
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) >= 0
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 0
RETURN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col1,
       player_age AS col2,
       t.team_name AS col3,
       p.name AS name_player
